title: Fwd Cargo Door Latch Hooks and Latching Web — Removal

issue.reason: Issue D. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the eight latch hooks and the latching web from the forward cargo door, with the load release sequence that stops the door taking up weight on a partly disconnected latch train.

sections.purpose: This task removes the eight latch hooks and the right-hand latching web kit from the forward cargo door so that the hooks can be replaced, the web can be re-machined, or the carriage can be installed.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the door open and the safety struts installed. The latch train must be released in the sequence given, not in numerical order: releasing the outer hooks first lets the door settle on the struts in a controlled way. The web is heavy and needs the support frame. Do not disconnect the proximity sensing harness until the hooks are out, because the harness route is used as a reference for re-installation.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the forward cargo door and install the safety struts. WARNING: THE DOOR WILL SETTLE ONTO THE STRUTS WHEN THE LATCH TRAIN IS RELEASED. KEEP CLEAR OF THE DOOR EDGE. 2. Put the latch mechanism in the unlocked position and pull the manual release. 3. Release hook stations 1 and 8, then 2 and 7, then 3 and 6, then 4 and 5. Do not release them in numerical order. 4. Remove the retaining hardware at each hook station and remove the eight hooks. Put them in the numbered tray; hook position matters for wear measurement. 5. Do a visual check of each hook bearing face and record which flank carries the wear. CAUTION: DO NOT MIX HOOK POSITIONS. THE WEAR RECORD IS USED TO SET THE FLEET INTERVAL. 6. Release the cable ties LN309661K1 that carry the door harness across the web and stow the harness clear. 7. Fit the web support frame and take the weight of the right-hand latching web kit D5230136217763. 8. Remove the web fasteners in the sequence on the fastener diagram and lower the web clear. 9. Do a visual check of the inboard shear ties GRA7840-60 and of the outboard skin panel HOD355133-89 for fretting at the seats. 10. Cover the open fastener holes.
sections.close_out: Put the hooks, the web and the hardware in the layout tray in station order. Make sure that the proximity target plate is not disturbed; if it has moved, record the fact so that the sensing gap is re-set at installation. Record the removal and the hook wear findings in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; step 6 applies only to aircraft post MOD-133110

safety_precautions: Install the door safety struts before the latch train is released.
Keep clear of the door edge during the release sequence.
Tag the door actuation circuit breakers.
